name: Clocks
tagline: World clocks, alarms, timers and a stopwatch

offers.label: Add world clock
offers.description: Adds a city's clock to the workspace.

offers.label: New alarm
offers.description: Sets an alarm: at the time of day `when` names, on the days it repeats on, ringing on

offers.label: Pause the stopwatch
offers.description: Pauses the stopwatch where it stands.

offers.label: Lap
offers.description: Keeps a lap: the time the stopwatch stands at.

offers.label: Reset the stopwatch
offers.description: Resets the stopwatch: it is at zero and stopped, with no laps.
